The Windows executable embeds a Python runtime and Tcl/Tk, and is packaged
with the PyInstaller bootloader and its runtime hooks. Their license texts
are included in this folder. PyInstaller's bootloader exception permits
distribution of the combined executable; the project's own code is MIT.

OpenSSL is used by the bundled Python runtime. See OPENSSL.txt (Apache 2.0).
Python, Tcl/Tk, OpenSSL and PyInstaller are separate projects and do not
endorse this application.

Singularity, its exploit binaries, Magisk APKs, Google platform-tools,
Android SDK/NDK and Java are not distributed in this release. Obtain those
separately from their respective authors under their own licenses.
